title: ShareSpot
tagline: Share your real-world finds with onchain friends - cool spots, eats, and buys, then get paid when your friends try them out. All on BASE.
description: We're focusing on easy onboarding and build fun usable apps a community can use. With ShareSpot we're focusing on bringing every expence of yours in the form of food, shopping, places your visit etc to be disocverable to your onchain friends - we usually like to discover things from our peers and give it a try based on what they think so bringing this experience onchain felt like a good opportunity to build for us.
how_its_made:
We're building a social app where users can share their real-world finds with onchain friends - cool spots, eats, and buys, then get paid when your friends try them out.

•⁠ ⁠All recommedations with pictures, notes and location saved onchain on base.

•⁠ ⁠Eventually reward for sharing and trying things your friends share etc.
